metadataRaw.title: How to Traction Your Neck and Back at the Same Time
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe goes over how to traction your neck and back AT THE SAME TIME. These decompression traction based exercises may give neck and lower back pain relief in as little as 30 SECONDS!

These exercises are going to focus on pulling motions, or spinal decompression TRACTION, to help open up the neck and low back.

A lot of neck pain and lower back pain is caused from strain and sprain in spine that can build pressure into the spinal discs. This may cause a lot of stiff achy pain, even pinching nerve pain (from a bulging or herniated disc) if it gets bad enough.

A safe way to fix this pressure on the spinal discs is to reduce the pressure within the spinal discs... or simply decompress the disc, by putting a pulling traction on the spinal joint. 

That way bulging material is brought back into the spinal disc, off any pinched nerves, which  allows you to HEAL and have less pain.

These exercises are SAFE, effective, don't require any special equipment, and can be done in the comfort of your own home.

WATCH NOW and traction your neck and lower back and get feeling instant relief!
